notes: Google confirmed building a data center in Chonburi (~100 jobs once operational); EIA conducted but findings not shared. BOI approved 32.8bn baht hyperscale data center by Quartz Computing (Alphabet subsidiary) in Chonburi. Baxtel notes Google's first Thailand data center is in a WHA industrial estate within the EEC in Chonburi. AI Data Center Index lists 100 MW planned. Construction observed in Dec 2025.
